faults.title: DPF clogging and glitchy infotainment (Mk5)
faults.description: On the 2022-on Mk5, Auto Express says lots of short trips can clog the exhaust filter, the hands-free microphone can play up, and the infotainment can get glitchy without regular software updates.

faults.title: Puncture-prone factory tyres (Mk5)
faults.description: Auto Express says the tyres fitted at the factory to the Mk5 are prone to punctures.

faults.title: Digital instrument cluster recall (Mk5)
faults.description: In July 2023 almost 7,000 Mk5s built August 2022 to March 2023 were recalled for software bugs in the digital instrument cluster. The fix was a software update.

faults.title: Brake servo recall (Mk5)
faults.description: A January 2025 recall covered nearly 3,000 Mk5s made September 2022 to June 2023 over brake servo failure, fixed with a software update.

faults.title: Factory tyres perishing early (Mk4)
faults.description: On the 2016-2021 Mk4, Auto Express says there are reports of the original tyres perishing early, which led many owners to switch to other premium brands.
